name: web-consent-cookie
description: PDPA/GDPR cookie consent widget + consent log API (Node.js, TypeScript, SQL Server)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @consent/widget && npm run build -w @consent/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @consent/widget && npm run typecheck -w @consent/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @consent/widget && npm run test -w @consent/server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @consent/widget && npm run dev -w @consent/server
